payload.body_they: {{Name}} may be drawn to relationships that feel meaningful before they have had much time to prove themselves. Strong chemistry or an unusual sense of understanding can make the connection feel important very quickly. The complication is letting that significance outweigh ordinary evidence about communication and follow-through. Feeling understood and having something dependable are different forms of intimacy. Chemistry tells {{Name}} that the connection matters. Follow-through tells them what the two of them can actually build.
